notes: Floating combat text 'MASTER-UNLOCKED' (7066) LEFT English on purpose: ftIsStatus (6793) and ftIsDebuff/FT_DEBUFF_RE (6799-6801) classify a float text by its English capitals/words to stack it over the head or under the feet. Translating txt at the push breaks that stacking in caseless scripts (ja/zh/ko/th/hi) and Cyrillic; whoever owns the float-text DRAW site should translate there and keep f.txt English. tests/test_debuff_feet_1141.js:64 asserts ftIsStatus({txt:'STUN'}) etc.
